answer: Sybil resistance works best when identities must wander. Each epoch, independent vantage nodes in different regions ping every seat and demand a signed reply; a real operator answers from one fixed home, while a clone farm's keys surface from the same few addresses. Route diversity is scored: traffic that always exits one hollow datacenter corner is downweighted however many keys back it. An attacker must rent a thousand homes in separate jurisdictions, each with real bills, from a reef in one ocean to a lagoon on another coast. Faking everywhere costs as much as being real somewhere.
